description: Start a new voicehook.ai voice call. `lang` = the language of the person being called (de or en, default de). Returns `human_url` (the link for the person; whoever opens it starts the call, on their own free allowance or credit), `share_text` (a ready message with human_url and the hint that the link needs a normal browser, because an app's built-in browser blocks the microphone), `operator_invite_url` (the agent's own link for `join`), `room` and `expires_in` (seconds until an unopened link expires, 30 min); `local_cli_hint` only for a local client with a shell (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and similar). join with operator_invite_url waits for the person (up to 200 s in Claude clients, else 50 s) and returns waiting_for_human with `next_action` until they open human_url; it can be repeated until the link expires (410), also from a background job over the HTTPS bridge. Errors: 429 = too many new calls right now. Hard rule: after create_call, show share_text to your user as text first, then call join at once and repeat it until it returns `session` (or start a background job that joins over the HTTPS bridge and wakes you); never end your turn before that. Then keep calling next in a loop.

lang.description: Language of the person you are calling (default de).
lang.title: Lang

name.description: Optional label for your own reference (not shown in the call; your name in the call comes from join).
name.title: Name

solo.description: true or left out (default) = solo call: the voicebot speaks as each joining agent, every agent in its own voice and in first person; more agents may join (e.g. a second model next to you). false = the voicebot speaks as itself and announces the agents.
solo.title: Solo
